We can construct this by taking the affine plane of order 4, which is a BIBD(16, 4, 1). The affine plane of order 4 has 16 points and 20 lines (blocks), where each line contains 4 points, and every pair of points determines exactly 1 line. By repeating each of the 20 blocks exactly 3 times, we obtain a BIBD(16, 4, 3) with 60 blocks.

The points of the affine plane can be represented as pairs (x, y) where x, y are elements of the finite field GF(4). The lines are given by the equations x = c and y = mx + c for all m, c in GF(4). Generating these lines, repeating them 3 times, and constructing the incidence matrix yields the valid solution.
